title: Jeremiah Imprisoned by the Leaders
description: When the Chaldean army withdrew from Jerusalem, Jeremiah went out to travel to the land of Benjamin to receive his share among the people. At the Benjamin Gate he was seized by the guard commander Irijah, who accused him of defecting to the Chaldeans. Jeremiah denied the accusation, but Irijah brought him before the leaders, who beat him and threw him into prison in the house of the scribe Jonathan, where he remained for many days. [ref:Jer 37:11-16|Jeremiah 37:11-16]
